channel.title: lucidité
channel.description: New things filed across Varun Agarwal's sites: photos, books, notes.

item.title: Wander: eUrope: The Clock
item.description: Three days set on one astronomical-clock dial at the minute each photo was taken, the real sky turning from day to night behind them. — 53 photos, Sept 3–6

item.title: Notes: Userscripts
item.description: Two Tampermonkey scripts I keep installed — a Wikipedia/Reddit/GitHub/PubMed research sidebar for Google Search, and a layout fix for the EAU Guidelines site.

item.title: Wander: Kanatal
item.description: A day climbing into the Garhwal Himalaya — ridgeline viewpoints, a terraced valley village, smoke haze from a hillside fire, and an evening into dawn at a homestay above the treeline. — 19 pieces · Uttarakhand 🇮🇳

item.title: Paws: Vanilluuu.
item.description: Golden retriever. Since 2021, and still going.

item.title: Paws: 🍪
item.description: Cat. A short while, in 2025.

item.title: Wander: eUrope: STRAAT
item.description: Amsterdam's street-art museum — murals, portraits and characters under one roof in a former shipyard warehouse. An experience more than a gallery, so it sits apart from the trip's own on-the-street formats above. — 55 pieces, Amsterdam

item.title: Wander: eUrope: The Wall
item.description: The East Side Gallery's murals, in walking order, with a scroll strip standing in for the wall itself — plus what's on either side of it. — 49 of 78 frames, Sept 2

item.title: Wander: eUrope: Contact Sheet
item.description: The whole roll, not just the keepers — every frame circled in grease pencil or passed over, left visible either way. — 15 of ~200 frames, Sept 1

item.title: Wander: eUrope: Postcards
item.description: A postcard-and-stamp drag canvas of the artwork itself — Van Gogh Museum and the Rijksmuseum so far, Berlin and Prague's museums still to come. — 40 pieces, Amsterdam

item.title: Wander: eUrope: On Film
item.description: A strip of negatives that develop into color on tap — the streets and corners between the museums, Amsterdam so far. — Amsterdam roll, growing

item.title: Wander: eUrope
item.description: Six ways into the trip so far — postcards from the museum walls, a film strip of everywhere else, a contact sheet from Berlin, the East Side Gallery wall, Prague on a clock face, and a warehouse of street art at STRAAT. — 6 sections · 🇳🇱🇩🇪🇨🇿

item.title: Wander: Manchester
item.description: A hundred-strong Bee in the City sculpture trail through the centre, then Northern Quarter murals, shutter art and Outhouse MCR's painted utility boxes. — 29 pieces · England 🇬🇧

item.title: Wander: Glasgow & Edinburgh
item.description: Camera-only — the Necropolis and Kelvingrove, then one long circuit round Calton Hill over all of Edinburgh. — 2 days · 12 photos · 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿

item.title: Wander: Street art
item.description: Specific pieces of street art, singled out — a curated tour through Shoreditch, Camden, Glasgow, Amsterdam and wherever comes next, with the full compendium one tap away.

item.title: Wander: Glasgow
item.description: The Necropolis at golden hour, Kelvingrove's taxidermy halls and pipe organ, the mural trail and a West End market. — 27 pieces · 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿

item.title: Wander: London: Camden
item.description: One evening around Camden Market and the backstreets off Hawley Street. — 11 pieces

item.title: Wander: Isle of Skye
item.description: The train up from Inverness, then four days round the island — Eilean Donan, the Cuillins, Fairy Pools, Neist Point, the Quiraing — then home past Glenfinnan. — 4 days · 42 photos · 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿
